title: Trash
whyItMatters: Deleted files sit in the Trash until it is emptied. A handover can pass on documents the owner thought they had removed.
source: SPEC.md macOS starter set and macOS forensics references: per-user Trash at ~/.Trash
notes: TCC-protected: without Full Disk Access a live scan gets a permission skip. Items are counted by metadata; per-volume .Trashes folders are out of scope.
